confirmatory_protocol.primary_metric: mean realized A_SBS per fresh disagreement state
confirmatory_protocol.primary_uncertainty: scenario-level bootstrap over supported fresh scenarios
steps: enumerate unique non-SBS candidate actions per fresh disagreement state
compute STATE_ACTION_V1 in frozen feature order
apply frozen V2 gate parameters without retraining or calibration
choose exactly one candidate action or abstain to SBS
only then join fresh A_SBS labels in the separate one-shot confirmation task
calculate realized gain against always-SBS baseline

FRESH_CONFIRMATION_FAIL: mean realized gain <= 0 or meaningful generalization is absent
FRESH_CONFIRMATION_SUCCESS: benefit not driven by a tiny number of scenarios
